strategy.offer: Provides eldercare, disability housing and support, mental health and psychosomatic treatment, training, research, and related practical services.
strategy.customers: Serves older adults, people with disabilities or mental illness, families and caregivers, learners, and institutional clients needing support or operational services.
strategy.why_we_win: Expects success through person-centered, needs-based support, active client participation, and flexible concepts spanning outpatient, residential, therapeutic, educational, and everyday-life assistance.
strategy.resources: Built on multidisciplinary professional teams, specialist medical and care expertise, practical therapy and production know-how, and a broad network of facilities.
